title: A Self-Contained Proof of Proposition (1 - 1.67440) for the Twin Prime Problem
description: Self-contained proof of Proposition (1 - 1.67440) on twin primes (p + 2 = rq, r = 1 or prime, r <= q^{0.67440}), using Ibarra's 1.2806 Chen lower bound and a delayed four-slot refinement, with directed integer certificates at denominator 2^80, improving Li and Liu's (1 - 1.75).
notes: The manuscript and PDF are CC BY 4.0. The baseline verifier and the W4 Python and C++ verification code are MIT-licensed. Complete replay: python w4/verify_w4_certificate.py --recompute-baseline (Python 3.10+ and a C++20 compiler with __int128 support).
